originality.rationale: The third-order Riccati update is *not* a new algorithm: Li, Zhang and Liu (arXiv:1907.12971, Eq. 23) already give exactly the same Erow3 map. Hochbruck et al. introduced the underlying exprb32 scheme. The proposed new contribution is the sharp noncommutative matrix inertia/damping law and the all-state scalar positivity criterion, not the scheme. The full texts of the 2019 and 2026 Riccati papers, as well as the 2009 defining integrator paper, contain the algorithm and implementation/convergence results but no equivalent sharp positivity phase diagram. The 2023 Chen-Borzì full article remains inaccessible and an earlier specialized analysis is a residual risk.
